atoms.exact_source_text: Once all proofs are satisfied, advancement becomes a Council-centered Home MEET or civic ceremony.
atoms.normalized_claim: Advancement occurs via a Council-centered Home MEET or civic ceremony once all proofs are satisfied.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Colony does not press an Age-up button.
atoms.normalized_claim: There is no Age-up button for the Colony to press.

atoms.exact_source_text: It recognizes what has become true: it can preserve its stores, receive its wounded, teach its young, send a party, and remain a home.
atoms.normalized_claim: Advancement recognizes what has already become true, including preserving stores, receiving wounded, teaching young, sending a party, and remaining a home.

atoms.exact_source_text: Graduation should visibly transform Home and unlock at least one new kind of decision.
atoms.normalized_claim: Graduation should visibly transform Home and unlock at least one new kind of decision.

atoms.exact_source_text: Exact Scrap, Artifact, knowledge, or relationship requirements may support a specific defining Project, but the game must avoid arbitrary giant payments that do not appear in the world.
atoms.normalized_claim: Exact resource requirements may support a defining Project, but the game must avoid arbitrary giant payments unreflected in the world.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Tier III Colony reduced from fourteen Citizens to ten remains an Independent Colony.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Tier III Colony reduced from fourteen to ten Citizens remains an Independent Colony.

atoms.exact_source_text: It retains its Places, Records, routes, knowledge, laws, relationships, and accumulated construction.
atoms.normalized_claim: A reduced Colony retains its Places, Records, routes, knowledge, laws, relationships, and accumulated construction.

atoms.exact_source_text: It may now be too small to cover all of that inheritance comfortably, but automatic downgrade would erase history and turn Tier into a volatile score.
atoms.normalized_claim: A shrunken Colony may struggle to cover its inheritance, but automatic downgrade is rejected because it would erase history and turn Tier into a volatile score.

atoms.exact_source_text: Population loss may force the player to close a Place, consolidate a court, suspend a route, seek Wanderers, or accept temporary Thinness.
atoms.normalized_claim: Population loss may force closing a Place, consolidating a court, suspending a route, seeking Wanderers, or accepting temporary Thinness.

atoms.exact_source_text: Those are meaningful consequences of carrying institutions with fewer hands.
atoms.normalized_claim: These outcomes are meaningful consequences of carrying institutions with fewer hands.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player may decide that the Colony is large enough.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player may decide the Colony is large enough and stop growth.

atoms.exact_source_text: Eleven Rabbits, sixteen Squirrels, or twenty-three Mice can be a complete civic world if the settlement is stable, remembered, and capable of chosen ambition.
atoms.normalized_claim: Small population counts like eleven Rabbits, sixteen Squirrels, or twenty-three Mice can constitute a complete civic world given stability, memory, and chosen ambition.

atoms.exact_source_text: The game must not create a universal pressure to fill every Residence or authorize every Nesting Season.
atoms.normalized_claim: The game must not create universal pressure to fill every Residence or authorize every Nesting Season.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tier III is a valid long plateau.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tier III is a valid long plateau.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tier IV is a particular corridor ambition, not the only successful shape of play.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tier IV is one particular corridor ambition, not the only successful shape of play.

atoms.exact_source_text: After the campaign climax, continued growth focuses on relationships, veteran care, ecological events, later generations, Guest hospitality, outpost refinement, and civic beauty - not infinite population or power scaling.
atoms.normalized_claim: Post-climax growth focuses on relationships, veteran care, ecological events, later generations, Guest hospitality, outpost refinement, and civic beauty rather than infinite population or power scaling.

atoms.exact_source_text: Growth should periodically disturb Quiet Equilibrium because new lives create real obligations.
atoms.normalized_claim: Growth should periodically disturb Quiet Equilibrium because new lives create real obligations.

atoms.exact_source_text: The intended rhythm is competence -\> stability -\> attention -\> attachment -\> chosen growth or accepted risk -\> restored stability.
atoms.normalized_claim: The intended rhythm is competence, then stability, then attention, then attachment, then chosen growth or accepted risk, then restored stability.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Colony that never has to absorb the consequences of growth feels decorative;
atoms.normalized_claim: A Colony that never absorbs the consequences of growth feels decorative.

atoms.exact_source_text: a Colony that can never become quiet leaves no attention available for attachment.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Colony that can never become quiet leaves no attention available for attachment.
